name: Constitution of Georgia article 94 reform (Social-Democrats for the Development of Georgia and 25 organisations incl. GTUC, 2017)
detail: Appeal to delete the clause that bars higher taxes without a referendum, argued as opening the way to progressive taxation. About income tax rates; the report does not mention wealth.

name: Sopiko Japaridze, ConstitutionNet and Jacobin op-eds on article 94 (June 2017)
detail: Argue that article 94 forecloses "taxing the rich" and progressive taxation; no wealth tax is named and nobody is quoted in favour of one.

name: Georgian Trade Unions Confederation (GTUC) May Day manifesto (May 2023)
detail: Reported by a secondary source as calling for a progressive income tax; the GTUC page opened held no tax text. No wealth in it.

name: Georgian property tax threshold changes (Georgian Dream, 2024-2025; economist Roman Gotsiridze comment)
detail: Annual property tax on real estate and vehicles above an income threshold: a property tax, not a tax on net wealth.

name: Georgian Dream offshore-assets tax amendments (April 2025) and critics
detail: The debate is about a tax exemption for repatriated offshore assets, criticised as serving Ivanishvili; no one calls for a wealth tax.
